bio.overview: Kevin Moore is an American keyboardist, composer, and founding member of the progressive metal band Dream Theater. Known for his atmospheric playing and thought-provoking lyrics, Moore contributed to Dream Theater's early albums including Images and Words and Awake.
extended_bio: Joined Dream Theater in 1986 and played on their debut album 'When Dream and Day Unite'
Key contributor to the band's breakthrough album 'Images and Words' (1992)
Left the band in 1994 to pursue solo projects and experimental music
Founded the progressive metal supergroup OSI with Jim Matheos and Mike Portnoy

trivia.did_you_know: Moore wrote the lyrics for 'Pull Me Under', Dream Theater's most commercially successful song.
